SiteStatus.title: SiteStatus
SiteStatus.description: Global online/offline availability state and maintenance message for DENZZ CLIENT.

online.description: Whether the main website is currently online and accessible to visitors.

message.description: Maintenance message displayed when the website is offline.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last status update.

updatedBy.description: Verified email of the admin who updated the status.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: Verified Google email address of the admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/siteStatus/{statusId}.description: Stores the global website online/offline status document (document ID: current).

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Stores authorized administrator accounts keyed by UID.
